final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT r.ordervault, u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ordervault) AS n FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault JOIN users AS u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink GROUP BY r.ordervault, u.acctscope), step2 AS (SELECT acctscope, SUM(n) AS n FROM step1 GROUP BY acctscope), step3 AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT s.acctscope, s.n, 1.0 * s.n / t.total AS share FROM step2 AS s CROSS JOIN step3 AS t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS mean_n FROM step4) SELECT s.acctscope, s.n, s.share, 1.0 * s.n / m.mean_n FROM step4 AS s CROSS JOIN step5 AS m WHERE m.mean_n IS NOT NULL
